contract: Pure interface/delivery compatibility and explicit-rank selection, with ambiguity rejection and deterministic presentation for well-formed duplicate-free sets.
limits: No lookup, placement, execution, payload validation or selected-implementation certification.
Malformed-candidate first-index errors deliberately depend on list order; no hot reconfiguration.

grounding.claim: Pinned Cure compilation checks consumed Port compatibility and delivery comparison over distinct SelectionCandidate/SelectionRequirement records.
Finite permutations, unique/ambiguous/incompatible/missing, phase-order, delivery drift, rank/delivery configuration, source audit and record ABI scenarios; no quantified proof.
Relies on pinned Cure type checking, structural equality and record/Result/tuple erasure.
Declared identities, interfaces, ranks and delivery needs are truthful; chosen implementations keep their own grounding.

telemetry.contract: Pure checks emit no observations; invoking Unit/Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Explicit per-call candidate rank and requirement delivery; no ambient settings or hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: No runtime lifecycle or operational commands.
